user.title: Add Packstations
user.description: Search an address or enter a specific station. No DHL account is required.

menu_options.search: Search an address or postal code

search.title: Find Packstations
search.description: Home is selected when your HA home location is available. Clear it with X to enter another address or postal code. The selected address or home coordinates are sent to DHL only when you submit the search, and are not saved.

data_description.address: Use one line: `10117` or `Georgenstraße 31, 10117 Berlin` (street and house number, postal code and city).

confirm.title: Review and confirm locations
confirm.description:
Check the addresses and counts. — means unknown, missing or old data; the station can still be added. ⚠ means the station could not be verified. Retry or deselect these stations.

“Enter compartment totals now” is optional: leave it off to finish setup immediately, or turn it on to enter the maximum counts per size for each station. You can also add or change them later under Edit station.

capacities.title: Compartment totals ({current} of {total})
capacities.description:
{station}

Enter the total number of S/M/L/XL compartments (maximum counts, not currently free compartments). DHL does not provide these per-size totals; count them on site or from a photo. These values are for display only. Leave any or all fields empty to continue. You can add or change totals later under Edit station. Empty means unknown; 0 means there are no compartments of that size.

error.cannot_connect: DHL could not be reached. Try again later.
error.station_not_found: DHL did not return this exact Packstation.
error.invalid_response: DHL returned unexpected data. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: DHL is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.invalid_address: Enter an address or postal code, up to 300 characters.
error.invalid_location: Enter a five-digit postal code and a positive station number with up to four digits.
error.no_stations: No new Packstations were found. Refine the address or use the station number.
error.validation_failed: Some stations could not be checked (⚠). Retry or deselect them.
error.invalid_capacities: Totals must be whole numbers between 0 and 1000. Leave unknown values empty.

abort.already_configured: DHL Packstation Monitor is already configured. Add stations to the existing entry.

reconfigure.title: Edit station
reconfigure.description: {station}: change the name and recheck the same location. Use Add station for a different Packstation. Optionally count the compartments per size on site or from a photo and enter or add them below later. These manual totals affect only the display, never DHL sensor values or availability checks. Empty fields mean unknown and remove previous values. Empty means unknown; 0 means there are no compartments of that size.

init.title: Global updates
init.description: Applies to every station. Maximum data age must be at least the polling interval.
